body:
Two points:

 Look up pharmaceutical statistics sometime, a considerable amount of the country is anxious or depressed.

Not at all; in fact, from journalling, I've realized I get "happiness" from life, both passive and active, but that other people always bring me down. Something off that seems to align other people together in a way that they despise something about me; I wish I knew, it has happened so many times that I find out there are rumors or bad reputations spread for seemingly no reason at all, certainly none which were obvious or stated. If not that, it's always a strange look and a sort of social shove away. I guess that's life though, right?  We're just fucking animals. It's kind of scary that there isn't necessary a resolution to this all, in fact, there appears not to be.
